verdict.rationale: The pack never documents fallback over TCP, TLS, or WebSocket when UDP is blocked, or when such a fallback engages. The only related items are a Rooms API mention of a "TURN configuration" property and a community remark that Twilio seems to offer TURN servers. Neither states transport fallback behavior, so this is adjacent at most and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, a stream survives a network that blocks UDP: the service documents fallback over TCP, TLS, or WebSocket and when it engages
